prompts:
Run one improvement cycle per docs/agent-improvement-loop.md section 3a.

Read AGENTS.md and .cursor/automation/hauldesk-improvement-cycle.prompt.md for full steps.

First: if branch claude/hauldesk-project-setup-l1luoo has commits not on main, review them against AGENTS.md and merge them to main. End your commit body with an updated "Backlog:" list. One item per run — if everything is green and the backlog is empty, stop without changes.
